summary: Anthropic launched the Services Track tiering system and Claude Partner Hub portal for its Claude Partner Network, giving consulting and services firms a structured way to demonstrate certification, deployment, and customer-reference status, including a new MCP connector linking the Hub to Claude.

mechanisms.reason: Large professional-services firms are rolling Claude out to hundreds of thousands of employees, implying a rise in aggregate usage.
mechanisms.quote: Cognizant has rolled Claude out to roughly 350,000 associates. Deloitte is making it available to 470,000 people across its global network.

practices.reason: A new MCP connector lets partners query Partner Hub data from within Claude, a new integration surface but optional and administrative rather than core-platform work.
practices.quote: Partners can connect the Partner Hub to Claude through a new MCP connector , and from there information about the partnership becomes a conversation.
